name: iobroker-javascript
description: Enables you to develop ioBroker scripts completely in Visual Studio Code, without the need of the web interface.

viewsWelcome.contents:
In order to use the ioBroker extension, you must connect to your ioBroker instance.
[Connect to ioBroker](command:iobroker-javascript.connect)

To learn more about how to use the extension [read the docs](https://github.com/nokxs/iobroker-javascript-vs-code-extension).

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_get_scripts
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the ioBroker.javascript directories and scripts that the extension knows about. Returns directory ids (use them as directoryId for creating or moving scripts) and script ids (use them as scriptId for all other tools) together with the local file path, engine type, enabled state and whether the script is dirty or remote only. Use it before any tool that needs a script or directory id. Does not read the script source code, use iobroker_get_script_content for that.

pathPrefix.description: Only return directories and scripts whose ioBroker id starts with this prefix, e.g. 'script.js.common.Licht'. Omit to get everything.

limit.description: Maximum number of scripts to return (1-500, default 200). Directories are always returned completely.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_get_script_content
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the source code of one ioBroker script. The local file is preferred; when the file does not exist the source stored on the ioBroker server is returned and 'fromDisk' is false. The result is marked as truncated when it exceeds maxLength. Only works for script ids, not for directories.

scriptId.description: Full ioBroker script id, e.g. 'script.js.common.MyScript'. Use iobroker_get_scripts to look it up.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters to return (default 50000). The result is marked as truncated when the source is longer.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_get_changed_scripts
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the ioBroker scripts whose local file differs from the version on the ioBroker server. Set 'refresh' to true to re-evaluate every script against the server first; that requires an active connection and is slower. Use iobroker_upload_all_changed_scripts to push the changes to the server.

refresh.description: Re-evaluate every script against the ioBroker server before answering. Slower but accurate. Default false.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_get_js_instances
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists the installed javascript adapter instances of ioBroker. When a scriptId is given, the result also contains the instance the script currently runs on. Read-only and requires an active ioBroker connection.

scriptId.description: Optional script id. When given, the result contains the javascript instance the script runs on.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_get_state
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads the current value of an ioBroker state, including the acknowledge flag and the timestamps. Use it to inspect what an ioBroker script produced or to debug state based logic. Requires an active ioBroker connection.

stateId.description: Full ioBroker state id, e.g. 'javascript.0.myState' or '0_userdata.0.temperature'.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_upload_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uploads the local content of one script to the ioBroker server and overwrites the server version. Unsaved editor content is not included, the file has to be saved first. Use iobroker_upload_all_changed_scripts to upload every changed script at once.

scriptId.description: Full ioBroker script id of the script that should be uploaded from disk to the ioBroker server.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_upload_all_changed_scripts
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Uploads every script whose local file differs from the ioBroker server. Returns the uploaded ids and the ids that failed with a reason. Use it after editing several scripts. Unsaved editor content is not included.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_download_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Downloads one script from the ioBroker server and overwrites the local file. Fails with the code 'unsaved_changes' when the file has unsaved editor changes; the user has to save or revert it first. Use it before reading a script that might have been changed on the server.

scriptId.description: Full ioBroker script id of the script that should be downloaded from the ioBroker server to disk. Fails when the file has unsaved editor changes.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_start_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Enables a script on the ioBroker server so the javascript adapter starts it. This does not upload anything, the server version is used. Requires an active ioBroker connection.

scriptId.description: Full ioBroker script id of the script that should be started (enabled) on the ioBroker server.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_stop_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Disables a script on the ioBroker server so the javascript adapter stops running it. The script itself stays on the server. Requires an active ioBroker connection.

scriptId.description: Full ioBroker script id of the script that should be stopped (disabled) on the ioBroker server.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_create_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Creates a new script on the ioBroker server and the matching local file. The same source is written to both places. Fails when a script or file with that name already exists in the directory. Pass a directoryId to place the script in a subdirectory; omit it to use the root directory.

directoryId.description: ioBroker id of the target directory, e.g. 'script.js.common'. Omit to create the script in the root directory. Use iobroker_get_scripts to look up available directories.

fileName.description: File name without extension, e.g. 'MyScript'. Must not contain path separators.

source.description: Initial source code. Written to the ioBroker server and to the local file. Defaults to an empty string.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_rename_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renames a script on the ioBroker server and renames the local file. The directory does not change; use iobroker_move_script for that. Returns the old and the new script id.

scriptId.description: Full ioBroker script id of the script to rename.

newName.description: New script name without path separators. The directory does not change.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_move_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Moves a script into another directory on the ioBroker server and moves the local file into the matching folder. The directory has to exist already. Returns the old and the new script id.

scriptId.description: Full ioBroker script id of the script to move.

targetDirectoryId.description: ioBroker id of the target directory, e.g. 'script.js.common'. Use iobroker_get_scripts to look up available directories.

languageModelTools.name: iobroker_delete_script
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Deletes a script on the ioBroker server and deletes the local file. This cannot be undone. Confirm the exact script id with the user before using this tool.

scriptId.description: Full ioBroker script id of the script that should be deleted on the ioBroker server and on disk.
